subtopics.title: 4G LTE Architecture and Elements
subtopics.summary: The 4G LTE network architecture and its key elements: base stations, the edge/core distinction, gateway and mobility-management components, and the separation of data and control planes.

subtopics.title: LTE Protocol Stacks and Radio Access Network
subtopics.summary: Protocol layering in LTE: the control-plane and data-plane protocol stacks and the radio access network connecting the mobile device to the base station.

subtopics.title: LTE Network Attachment and Power Management
subtopics.summary: How a mobile device attaches (registers) to an LTE network and the power-management techniques used to conserve device battery life.

subtopics.title: Global Cellular Network of Networks
subtopics.summary: How a carrier's network interconnects with other carrier networks and the larger Internet to form a global cellular 'network of networks,' mirroring Internet architectural principles.

subtopics.title: 5G Cellular Technology
subtopics.summary: Emerging 5G cellular technology: new frequency bands (including millimeter-wave FR2), increased cell density, wider available spectrum, and MIMO/beam-forming for improved spectral efficiency.
